# 只读存储检查：不得删除对象
对用户给出的 bucket 调用 list_objects；只有返回 truncated=true 时才按原游标继续读取。
若游标缺失则停止并追问，不得把缺失当作没有更多对象。
示例 bucket demo 只是文档示例，不能当作用户参数。

d001-l0001.statement: The document title establishes a read-only storage check constraint prohibiting object deletion.

d001-l0002.statement: Invoke list_objects on the bucket provided by the user.
Continue reading using the original cursor only if list_objects returns truncated=true.

d001-l0003.statement: Stop and ask for clarification if the cursor is missing.
Do not treat a missing cursor as indicating no more objects exist.

d001-l0004.statement: Do not use the example bucket 'demo' as a user parameter.

documents.text:
# Change ticket priority
Read ticket T-42, then request approval for setting its priority to high.
Only when that approval is valid may update_ticket set priority to high; an open ticket is not approval.
If approval is unavailable or denied, stop without calling update_ticket.
After the update, read the priority again; a mismatch must be reported as failure, not success.

d001-l0001.statement: The document defines a skill for changing ticket priority.

d001-l0002.statement: Request approval for setting the priority to high.

d001-l0003.statement: Only when approval is valid may update_ticket set priority to high.
An open ticket is not considered approval.

d001-l0004.statement: If approval is unavailable or denied, stop without calling update_ticket.

d001-l0005.statement: After the update, read the priority again.
If a mismatch is found, report it as failure.
Do not report success if a mismatch is found.

# Observe only
Read the requested sensor once. Apply the interpretation limits in references/limits.md.
If reading.status is not stale, finish; otherwise request human interpretation without taking another reading.

A stored reading is not a live measurement.
Do not infer equipment safety or permission to change settings from reading.status.
